messages:
devin: CI perf alert on PR #17654 — microbench `batch_latency_p50` up +6.8% vs golden, failing threshold. cc @maria @sanjay :eyes:
ci-bot: perf-checker: PR 17654 failed threshold. metric=batch_latency_p50 delta=+6.8% (12.40ms -> 13.25ms). test=bench/micro/batcher_unit. report: http://ci/reports/17654
maria: can you paste the short bench output + kv stats?
devin: pasted output below:
```
bench summary:
batch_latency_p50 baseline 12.40ms -> 13.25ms (+6.8%)
batch_latency_p95 baseline 28.1ms -> 30.7ms (+9.2%)
kv_cache_hit_rate baseline 0.79 -> 0.52 (-34%)
kernel_selected: conv_fallback_v2 (prev: conv_fast_v1)
cmd: ./bench/run_micro.sh --ci --profile
```

sanjay: whoa kv hit drop is huge. looks like kernel selector fell back which changed prefetch/ordering and heated different shards -> KV thrash. i'll start a git bisect across recent merges (batch-sampler-refactor range).
devin: repro'd locally on `bench/image:ci-2026-03-19` (docker). profiler flame shows hot in `select_best_kernel` and repeated `kv::lookup_shard` misses. logs show `select_best_kernel -> try_fallback -> choose(conv_fallback_v2)` repeated for many micro-batches.
maria: if fallback family disables the prefetch path we rely on for small sequence tiling that's consistent. weird this regressed with the sampler change.
sanjay: bisect update: culprit commit is `3f7e2b9` (merge: batch-sampler: prefer even-split for short seqs). reverting sampler preference locally restores kv_hit ~0.78 and batch_latency back to baseline.
devin: created hotfix branch `pr-17654/force-conv-fast` to force kernel family to `conv_fast_v1` for CI and smoke tests while we fix the selector. kicking off a forced run.
ci-bot: rerun triggered: bench/ci/17654-force-kernel job=17654-02
ci-bot: rerun complete. metric=batch_latency_p50 now -0.4% vs golden (12.35ms). kv_cache_hit_rate restored 0.78. :white_check_mark:
maria: good signal. this narrows it to an interaction: sampler change -> different shard access pattern -> selector picks fallback kernel -> prefetch path changes -> kv miss spike. we should make selector prefer stable families during warmup and avoid changing prefetch semantics.
sanjay: i'll open a small PR to add a warmup-stability bias to kernel selector + unit tests in microbench harness to assert kv_hit drop <10% across sampler toggle.
devin: rollout blocked until fix / revert. tagging @release-bot. :no_entry:
release-bot: noted. blocking label applied to PR 17654.
devin: Action items: 1) maria to draft selector fallback patch (WIP) 2) sanjay to add microbench regression test + bisect notes 3) devin to keep hotfix branch for staging and coordinate canary. Will track in PR comments.
maria: ack, starting draft now.
sanjay: ack, test PR after lunch.
devin: thanks — keeping this thread as the bisect/fix tracker.
